subject: executor: force pushdown aggregate to TiKV inside `admin check table` (#63665)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent, focusing on executor/sessionctx behavior. In `pkg/executor/check_table_index.go`, internal checksum queries used by fast `admin check table` now add `/*+ AGG_TO_COP() */` (and keep `read_from_storage(tikv[...])` on the table-side query) plus intest/internal-check-only assertions that the index-side plan contains `IndexFullScan` and not `TableFullScan`. Verified the new `queryToRow` helper uses `sqlexec.DrainRecordSetAndClose` (close errors logged, not surfaced) matching prior close-error handling. In `pkg/sessionctx/variable/session.go`, `SkipMissingPartitionStats` is initialized to `vardef.DefTiDBSkipMissingPartitionStats` (true). No plausible Blocker/High issues found in correctness, SQL semantics, transaction/session behavior, or compatibility for the touched runtime paths.
